messages.subject: Project Indigo — diligence and counsel
messages.plaintextBody:
Anita, Sarah — pleased to be moving ahead. Tom Ashworth leads for us on the deal; Oliver Jennings at Birchall Stone is our counsel. Oliver will send a legal DD request list this week. We'd like to target a completion in the first week of March. Our investment committee has approved subject to confirmatory diligence and final docs.

Eleanor

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — our DD request list is in the data room Q&A. Priority items: the coupler patent family prosecution status, the Aldridge convertible note terms, the top-5 customer contracts (especially change-of-control), and the option scheme. We'll produce a report for Brindley by end of Feb.

Oliver
